statement: The external MotionPlus calibration format and Dolphin emulator source describe 32 bytes of fast/slow gain/zero metadata with CRC32 split into halves; no captured authentic early Plus or TR calibration images or checksums are available to compare. Equality or differences in built-in MP CRC, UID, inactive/active calibration 20, downstream ID F6, F7 challenge, cached accessory 40, 50 challenge data and reset/mode transitions remain unknown, despite consumer implementation reuse. Emulator-synthesized calibration cannot promote those to physical truth.

applicability.revision: Original RVL-003, early integrated RVL-036 non-TR, later RVL-036 TR; no physical revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: device. Dolphin MotionPlus.cpp 95-154, header MotionPlus.h 20-77, WiiBrew oldid120079 calibration; prior #46 and #49 are separate claims. Source-only physical unknowns. All proposed physical or host tests are not run.
